title: Late outcomes land on the decisions that made a list, finished cases become case-file examples with their source, and code is kept by the existing replay
request: The owner: build all of Phase 13 but switch-on.
spec: 37.16 a call list's results land on every decision of its project as a measured business outcome, on a schedule; 37.17 finished cases sorted into a set with their source, never edited; 37.18 code from every source kept and replayed against forgetting.
plan: Reuse ledger.outcomes.observe for the follower and an inbox for the schedule
A set builder for finished cases beside the workflow sets

decisions.decision: The follower measures the listed rows' outcome rate against the others', never a row
decisions.why: a measured label of what followed, with the row floor every number has

decisions.decision: The case set is built by code and spends nothing; a model-run curator may judge it later
decisions.why: the night's money went to the sealed exam; the record is the case's own versions

decisions.decision: 37.18 is covered by 36.4 to 36.6 (code sets, replay, pinned exams); Phase 13 adds no code source
decisions.why: the lead agent writes no code; nothing new to keep

change: dclab_rnd/ledger/follow.py (list_result, follow_inbox, make outcomes-follow); dclab_rnd/store/sets/cases.py (m4_workflow_llm/case_files: the conversation in, the case file out, simulated or real) hooked into the workflow sets' build; traces: only a list under rows is scrubbed (a row count stays).

findings.defect: Scrubbing every rows key removed row counts from trace rows
findings.scenario: test_store_m5_trajectories: a tool result's rows: 2000 was dropped from its step
findings.cause: 37.6 added rows to the cell keys whatever its value
findings.fix: rows is scrubbed only when it holds a list (a query's groups)

findings.defect: Three tests named the old event version
findings.scenario: rd-check: v16 expected where events now read as v17
findings.cause: case.changed moved the experience contract to v17

measurements.name: follower and case set, scripted
measurements.gate: a list's results land on every decision; a small group is refused; cases carry their source
measurements.result: three follower tests and one case-set test pass; the store's set tests pass

outcome: What followed a list can now reach the decisions that made it, nightly from an inbox, and every finished case becomes a case-file example labelled with where it came from.
lessons: A scrub by key name must look at the value: the same key can hold a count or the data
Reuse the writer that already lands outcomes: the follower only computes the number
risks: The case set waits for kept conversations and drafts with a case in the store; a model-run curator is not wired to it yet
The follower needs the list and the results in its inbox: the product does not put them there yet
